deviations: Paper text supplied is an earlier working-paper version without the regression tables or the online experiment; specifications follow the task's quantity descriptions.

Controls: age, female, field of study (subject_cat), A-level GPA quartile indicators with a missing-GPA category (q_abitur_grade_cat, keeps N constant), last math grade quartile indicators (q_math_grade_cat), background- and decision-task ability from the practice parts, perceived multitasking (5-point Likert item perc_multitasking_1), payoff-scheme (10/20/40) and wave (original_lab) indicators.
Online controls: age, gender (3-level factor), screen size as browser window height and width.
notes: Lab sample = Scarce condition (Treatment_Incentives 10/20/40) in Baseline, Directed Attention and Forced Choice: 12160 subject-rounds, 608 subjects. OLS via fixest::feols with subject-clustered SEs. Outcomes: summation_correct (choice quality), default_followed (default adherence), load_correct (background task), payoff_share (Table 4). Online: memory on Treatment_intervention, 5472 obs, 608 subjects, clustered by subject. attempt-1 was exploratory (variable inspection, no RESULT lines); attempt-2 crashed in a print statement before RESULT lines and was fixed without changing the specification.
